module_purpose: The research module introduces students to geography and environment studies research techniques, leading to successful producing a research proposal. Since this is a students’ first attempt of developing research proposal, the module, the students will be relatively assisted by the module coordinator within the department through all the stages. This module provides a framework for geographical research methodology, including identifying a research problem, problem statement, set short-term goals and ask pertinent questions, uncover background literature and appropriate research design and interpretation in a scientific manner.
